notes.title: THANKS FOR PLAYING!!
notes.notes:
We didn't expect that Luminescence has been played by more than 500 people. We're very happy to see that.

Thanks for everyone for the review  and feedback. we'll keep improving ourselves so we can give our players the best experience with our games. We've improve English translation in this update. Steam collection card will be available in the next update.

Thanks for all the support!! Going strong! Let's hit the next milestone!! '-')9

Updates:
- Improve English translation
- Add hover and click sound
